name: Grievver Valley
title: Grievver Valley
summary: A deep, wooded valley full of grievvers at 75.9N 19.0W, near Stonehold. The floor runs from z 50 to 75 between walls that rise 90-130 m. At the valley head, at the foot of a 90 m wall, a stone-framed 28 m ruin floor with scattered stones marks the mouth of the Grievver Caves, added in Castling. A cluster of glowing spider webs hangs at (19788, 42636) on the floor.

landmarks.name: Grievver Caves mouth
landmarks.note: Stone-framed ruin floor 0x010029E2 (28 x 29 m) with 29 scattered stones at the foot of the 90 m head wall.

site.name: Grievver Valley
site.notes: Derived @teleloc on the open valley floor 22 m south-west of the cave-mouth ruin (ground 73.2, 5.2 m from the ruin floor's edge, >= 6 m from the pines); the gazetteer has no outdoor entry in the valley.

shots.standingOrder: Look straight down on the stone-framed mouth of the Grievver Caves at the foot of the valley's 90 m head wall and climb from 32 m to 85 m, rotating 35 degrees, until the wooded Grievver Valley opens around it.
shots.notes: Top-down rise. The camera looks straight down on the stone-framed Grievver Caves mouth at the foot of the valley's 90 m head wall and climbs from 32 m to 85 m, rotating 35 deg. The wooded valley, its walls and the grievver ground open around the dungeon entrance. A small rank-3 view.
